suggestions: reorder joins to reduce intermediate rows
optimized_sql:
SELECT i_item_id, i_item_desc, s_store_id, s_store_name,
       MAX(ss_net_profit) AS store_sales_profit,
       MAX(sr_net_loss) AS store_returns_loss,
       MAX(cs_net_profit) AS catalog_sales_profit
FROM (
    SELECT ss_customer_sk, ss_item_sk, ss_store_sk,
           MAX(ss_net_profit) AS ss_net_profit,
           MAX(sr_net_loss) AS sr_net_loss
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN store_returns
      ON ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number
     AND ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk
     AND ss_customer_sk = sr_customer_sk
    JOIN date_dim d1
      ON ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d2
      ON sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
    WHERE d1.d_moy = 4
      AND d1.d_year = 1999
      AND d2.d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 10
      AND d2.d_year = 1999
    GROUP BY ss_customer_sk, ss_item_sk, ss_store_sk
) AS store_sales_returns_agg
JOIN (
    SELECT cs_bill_customer_sk, cs_item_sk,
           MAX(cs_net_profit) AS cs_net_profit
    FROM catalog_sales
    JOIN date_dim d3
      ON cs_sold_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk
    WHERE d3.d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 10
      AND d3.d_year = 1999
    GROUP BY cs_bill_customer_sk, cs_item_sk
) AS catalog_sales_agg
  ON store_sales_returns_agg.ss_customer_sk = catalog_sales_agg.cs_bill_customer_sk
 AND store_sales_returns_agg.ss_item_sk = catalog_sales_agg.cs_item_sk
JOIN item
  ON item.i_item_sk = store_sales_returns_agg.ss_item_sk
JOIN store
  ON store.s_store_sk = store_sales_returns_agg.ss_store_sk
GROUP BY i_item_id, i_item_desc, s_store_id, s_store_name
ORDER BY i_item_id, i_item_desc, s_store_id, s_store_name
LIMIT 100
